stations.title: Marble run
stations.shows: An iron marble rolls down an oak ramp.
stations.law: Gravity, contact friction and rolling resistance on rigid bodies

stations.title: Dominoes
stations.shows: Eight oak dominoes knock each other over.
stations.law: Rigid contacts pass momentum along the row; each one topples about its edge

stations.title: Lever
stations.shows: The last domino presses down one end of a hinged plank; the far end rises.
stations.law: A hinge: torque about a pin, between limits

stations.title: Electric switch
stations.shows: Past 8 degrees the lever closes a switch. A 48 V battery drives current through a coil.
stations.law: DC circuit: Ohm's and Kirchhoff's laws; the coil's Joule heat goes into the peg

stations.title: Burning peg
stations.shows: The coil heats the oak peg holding the weight. Oak chars and burns, and loses strength as it heats.
stations.law: Heat conduction, oak combustion with oxygen, strength falling with temperature

stations.title: Falling weight
stations.shows: When the peg gives way, the iron weight drops.

stations.title: Glass plate
stations.shows: The weight lands on a glass plate resting on two supports.
stations.law: Bonded-cell fracture: whether it breaks is calculated; the number of pieces is not calibrated

stations.title: Water wheel
stations.shows: Next: pour water over a wheel and let it turn.
stations.law: Not in this shared world yet. A separate reference calculates particles of water on a wheel.
